about.title: About Us
about.headline: Our Story
about.subtitle: Tradition meets passion. We bring the authentic flavors of Italian and Mediterranean cuisine to Linden. With a wide range of vegetarian options.
about.story_p1: {name} began with a simple idea: to combine the rich culinary tradition of Italian and Mediterranean cuisine with a modern ambience.
about.story_p2: Every dish tells a story of herbs, patience, and love for detail. We exclusively use fresh ingredients.
about.philosophy_subtitle: What drives us and what we stand for.
about.quality_text: We use only the best ingredients, daily fresh from the market.
about.hospitality_text: Every guest is part of our family. Your well-being comes first.
about.tradition_text: We honor ancient cooking techniques and preserve authentic flavors.
gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.description:
Be inspired by the atmosphere and our culinary creations in this visual journey through Lindener Ratsstuben. Our gallery offers a glimpse into the warm, inviting ambiance that awaits you, capturing the essence of our carefully designed dining spaces.

Browse through mouth-watering images of our authentic Italian and Mediterranean dishes, thoughtfully plated to showcase our passion for fresh ingredients and culinary artistry. Every photo tells a story of tradition, flavor, and dedication to excellence.

We hope these impressions whet your appetite and encourage you to experience our restaurant firsthand. We take pride in creating an environment where beautiful surroundings perfectly complement outstanding food.
contact.title: Contact
contact.description:
Do you have questions, suggestions, or would you like to give us feedback? We are always here for you to ensure your experience with us is nothing short of exceptional.

Whether you're inquiring about special dietary accommodations, large group bookings, or just want to share your thoughts on a recent visit, our dedicated team is eager to assist. We value the open dialogue with our guests as it helps us continually improve and perfect our craft.

Please don't hesitate to reach out via phone or email, or drop by in person during our opening hours. We strive to respond to all inquiries as promptly as possible, because your satisfaction and well-being remain our highest priority.
reservation.title: Reserve Table
reservation.description:
Secure your seat for an unforgettable culinary experience at Lindener Ratsstuben. We highly recommend booking your table in advance, especially during weekends and special holidays, to guarantee the best spot for you and your loved ones.

Our reservation process is quick and simple, designed to accommodate both intimate dinners and larger family gatherings. Let us know of any special occasions or specific seating preferences so we can tailor the evening exactly to your wishes.

We kindly ask that you inform us of any delays or changes in your party size as early as possible. We look forward to welcoming you soon and providing you with our signature hospitality and exquisite Mediterranean cuisine.
menu.title: Menu
menu.subtitle: Our Selection
menu.description:
Welcome to our menu, featuring a delightful fusion of German and Italian cuisine, all freshly prepared with the highest quality ingredients. We believe that great food starts with exceptional produce, sourced daily from local markets and trusted regional partners.

From classic pasta dishes and crispy oven-baked pizzas to hearty German specialties and vibrant vegetarian options, our culinary team has crafted a selection that caters to every palate. Every recipe reflects our deep respect for traditional cooking techniques combined with a modern twist.

Please explore our diverse offerings and don't hesitate to ask our staff for the perfect wine pairing to elevate your meal. All our prices are listed in Euro, and we are happy to accommodate specific dietary requirements upon request.

kegelbahn.hero.subtitle: Reserve our in-house bowling alley for unforgettable evenings with friends, family, or colleagues. Experience sports, fun, and good food in a cozy atmosphere.
kegelbahn.features.lanes.title: Two Modern Lanes
kegelbahn.features.lanes.desc: Our two well-maintained bowling lanes offer space for large and small groups. Ideal for birthdays, company parties, or the regular bowling club.
kegelbahn.features.dining.title: Food & Drinks
kegelbahn.features.dining.desc: Enjoy our delicious Italian and Mediterranean specialties as well as cool drinks right at the lane while you play.
kegelbahn.pricing.title: Prices
kegelbahn.pricing.hourly_desc: Rent the lane flexibly per hour. Perfect for spontaneous trips or shorter game nights.
kegelbahn.pricing.package_desc: For longer celebrations, we offer special packages including catering and unlimited playing time.
kegelbahn.catering.title: Catering
kegelbahn.catering.snacks_desc: Small refreshments for in between, freshly prepared from our kitchen.
kegelbahn.catering.drinks_desc: A large selection of draft beers, wines, and non-alcoholic refreshments.
kegelbahn.rules.title: Rules
kegelbahn.rules.r1_desc: Please only enter the lanes with clean sports shoes to protect the surface.
kegelbahn.rules.r2_desc: The consumption of outside food and drinks is not permitted on the bowling alley.
kegelbahn.rules.r3_desc: Please arrive on time for your reserved slot to ensure a smooth schedule.
kegelbahn.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
kegelbahn.faq.q1: How many people can play on one lane?
kegelbahn.faq.a1: We recommend a maximum of 10-12 people per lane for an optimal playing experience.
kegelbahn.faq.q2: Do I need to bring my own shoes?
kegelbahn.faq.a2: Yes, please bring clean indoor sports shoes. We do not offer shoe rentals.
kegelbahn.faq.q3: Can we order food in advance?
kegelbahn.faq.a3: Yes, for larger groups we recommend ordering food in advance to avoid waiting times.
